evidence: frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/errorHandler.ts:271-278 — parseHttpStatusError maps HTTP 403 (Forbidden) to code 'UNAUTHORIZED' with the UNAUTHORIZED copy, while 401 (line 263-270) maps to 'AUTHENTICATION_ERROR'. 403 is an authorization (permission) failure, not an authentication/session failure; labelling it UNAUTHORIZED conflates 'you are not permitted' with 'you are not signed in'.

Impact: the parsed .code for a 403 is indistinguishable from a genuine auth failure, so any UI/branch that treats UNAUTHORIZED/AUTHENTICATION_ERROR as 'session invalid -> redirect to login / clear session' would wrongly log the user out on a mere permission denial. This fallback path fires whenever a 403 arrives WITHOUT a structured backend ErrorResponse body (the structured-body path at line 164-166 uses the backend's own data.error and is unaffected).

Severity low (copy/semantic mislabel on a fallback branch; no crash). Confidence medium: the mapping is unambiguous on static read; whether it triggers a logout cascade depends on downstream consumers of .code. Fix: give 403 its own code (e.g. 'FORBIDDEN'/'PERMISSION_DENIED') with a distinct catalogue entry, or at minimum stop reusing the auth-error copy so 403 is not treated as a session-expiry.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts:47-49 — getOnlineSnapshot() reads `navigator.onLine` with no `typeof navigator !== 'undefined'` guard, while its two sibling helpers in the same file DO guard it: getInitialOnlineStatus (line 27-29) and the exported isOnline() (line 200-202) both return `typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true`.

getOnlineSnapshot is the client `getSnapshot` passed to useSyncExternalStore (line 82-86); getServerSnapshot covers SSR, so in a real browser this never throws. But the inconsistency is a latent hazard: any non-DOM execution of the client snapshot (a test/renderer without a `navigator` global, a future non-browser host) throws a ReferenceError where the guarded siblings degrade gracefully to 'online'.

Severity low (robustness/consistency; practically inert in-browser). Confidence medium. Fix: guard getOnlineSnapshot identically — `return typeof navigator !== 'undefined' ? navigator.onLine : true;` — so all three read paths share one hardened accessor.

frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/contexts/OrganizationProvider.tsx:8-12 — the context `value` is rebuilt as a fresh object literal on every render (`user?.organizationId ? { organizationId, organizationName } : null`) with no useMemo. It is passed directly to <OrganizationContext.Provider value={value}>.

OrganizationProvider re-renders whenever the AuthContext value changes; notably a silent token refresh (contexts/AuthContext.tsx refreshTokenInternal -> setUser(updated), line 433-435) produces a NEW user object even when organizationId is unchanged. Each such render hands useOrganization consumers a new context-value identity, forcing them all to re-render even though organizationId/organizationName did not change.
